rows.note: Use it before a noun for something acrobat-related or involving acrobatic performance; this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: This show has lots of acrobatic moves and is a real feast for the eyes.
example.traditional: 呢套表演有好多雜技動作，睇到人目不暇給。
